<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Snake</title>
<style>
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#0a0a0a;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
canvas{display:block;image-rendering:pixelated}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c"></canvas>
<script>
const W=480,H=480,C=24,COLS=W/C,ROWS=H/C;
const canvas=document.getElementById('c');
const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
canvas.width=W;canvas.height=H;

let snake,dir,nextDir,food,score,best=0,state,tick,elapsed,speed;

function init(){
  snake=[{x:10,y:10},{x:9,y:10},{x:8,y:10}];
  dir={x:1,y:0};nextDir={x:1,y:0};
  score=0;speed=110;elapsed=0;state='play';
  placeFood();
}

function placeFood(){
  let open=[];
  for(let x=0;x<COLS;x++)for(let y=0;y<ROWS;y++){
    if(!snake.some(s=>s.x===x&&s.y===y))open.push({x,y});
  }
  food=open[Math.random()*open.length|0];
}

function update(){
  dir=nextDir;
  let head={x:snake[0].x+dir.x,y:snake[0].y+dir.y};
  if(head.x<0||head.x>=COLS||head.y<0||head.y>=ROWS||
     snake.some(s=>s.x===head.x&&s.y===head.y)){
    state='over';best=Math.max(best,score);return;
  }
  snake.unshift(head);
  if(head.x===food.x&&head.y===food.y){
    score++;speed=Math.max(55,110-score*2);
    placeFood();
  }else{snake.pop()}
}

function draw(){
  ctx.fillStyle='#0d1117';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

  // subtle grid
  ctx.strokeStyle='#161b22';ctx.lineWidth=0.5;
  for(let i=1;i<COLS;i++){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(i*C,0);ctx.lineTo(i*C,H);ctx.stroke()}
  for(let i=1;i<ROWS;i++){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,i*C);ctx.lineTo(W,i*C);ctx.stroke()}

  // food glow
  let pulse=0.6+0.4*Math.sin(Date.now()*0.006);
  let grd=ctx.createRadialGradient(food.x*C+C/2,food.y*C+C/2,2,food.x*C+C/2,food.y*C+C/2,C*1.2);
  grd.addColorStop(0,`rgba(255,107,53,${0.18*pulse})`);grd.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,107,53,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle=grd;ctx.fillRect(food.x*C-C,food.y*C-C,C*3,C*3);

  // food
  ctx.fillStyle='#ff6b35';
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(food.x*C+C/2,food.y*C+C/2,C/2-3,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();

  // snake
  snake.forEach((s,i)=>{
    let t=1-i/snake.length;
    let r=Math.round(56+80*t),g=Math.round(217+30*t),b=Math.round(169-80*t);
    ctx.fillStyle=`rgb(${r},${g},${b})`;
    let pad=i===0?1:2,rad=i===0?6:4;
    roundRect(s.x*C+pad,s.y*C+pad,C-pad*2,C-pad*2,rad);
    if(i===0){
      // eyes
      ctx.fillStyle='#0d1117';
      let ex=s.x*C+C/2+dir.x*4,ey=s.y*C+C/2+dir.y*4;
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(ex+dir.y*3,ey-dir.x*3,2,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(ex-dir.y*3,ey+dir.x*3,2,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
    }
  });

  // HUD
  ctx.fillStyle='#c9d1d9';ctx.font='bold 14px monospace';ctx.textBaseline='top';
  ctx.fillText('SCORE '+score,12,8);
  ctx.fillStyle='#484f58';ctx.fillText('BEST '+best,W-80,8);

  if(state==='over'){
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(10,10,10,0.75)';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    ctx.fillStyle='#e6edf3';ctx.font='bold 28px monospace';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';
    ctx.fillText('GAME OVER',W/2,H/2-30);
    ctx.fillStyle='#8b949e';ctx.font='16px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('Score: '+score,W/2,H/2+10);
    ctx.fillStyle='#ff6b35';ctx.font='14px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('Press any key to restart',W/2,H/2+44);
    ctx.textAlign='left';
  }
}

function roundRect(x,y,w,h,r){
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x+r,y);ctx.lineTo(x+w-r,y);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+r);
  ctx.lineTo(x+w,y+h-r);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x+w,y+h,x+w-r,y+h);ctx.lineTo(x+r,y+h);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x,y+h,x,y+h-r);ctx.lineTo(x,y+r);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x,y,x+r,y);ctx.fill();
}

function keyHandler(e){
  let k=e.key;
  if(state==='over'){init();return}
  let map={'ArrowUp':{x:0,y:-1},'ArrowDown':{x:0,y:1},'ArrowLeft':{x:-1,y:0},'ArrowRight':{x:1,y:0},
           'w':{x:0,y:-1},'s':{x:0,y:1},'a':{x:-1,y:0},'d':{x:1,y:0},
           'W':{x:0,y:-1},'S':{x:0,y:1},'A':{x:-1,y:0},'D':{x:1,y:0}};
  let nd=map[k];
  if(nd&&!(nd.x===-dir.x&&nd.y===-dir.y)){nextDir=nd;e.preventDefault()}
}

document.addEventListener('keydown',keyHandler);
canvas.setAttribute('tabindex','0');
canvas.addEventListener('click',()=>canvas.focus());
canvas.focus();

init();
let last=0;
function loop(ts){
  let dt=ts-last;last=ts;
  if(state==='play'){elapsed+=dt;if(elapsed>=speed){update();elapsed=0}}
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<style>
  html, body { margin: 0; padding: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; background: #111; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; overflow: hidden; }
  canvas { display: block; background: #282c34; border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); touch-action: none; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" width="480" height="480"></canvas>
<script>
const c = document.getElementById('c'), ctx = c.getContext('2d');
const W = c.width, H = c.height;
let state = 0, score = 0, lives = 3;
const pad = { w: 80, h: 12, x: 0, y: H - 40, spd: 6 };
const ball = { r: 6, x: 0, y: 0, dx: 0, dy: 0, spd: 5 };
const brick = { rows: 6, cols: 8, w: 0, h: 18, pad: 6, top: 50 };
brick.w = (W - (brick.cols + 1) * brick.pad) / brick.cols;
let bricks = [], keys = {};
const colors = ['#e06c75', '#d19a66', '#e5c07b', '#98c379', '#61afef', '#c678dd'];

function init() {
  score = 0; lives = 3;
  pad.x = (W - pad.w) / 2;
  ball.x = W / 2; ball.y = pad.y - ball.r;
  ball.dx = ball.spd * (Math.random() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1); ball.dy = -ball.spd;
  bricks = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < brick.rows; i++) {
    bricks[i] = [];
    for (let j = 0; j < brick.cols; j++) {
      bricks[i][j] = { x: brick.pad + j * (brick.w + brick.pad), y: brick.top + i * (brick.h + brick.pad), alive: 1 };
    }
  }
  state = 1;
}

function rect(x, y, w, h, r) {
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + r, y); ctx.lineTo(x + w - r, y);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + r); ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h - r);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - r, y + h); ctx.lineTo(x + r, y + h);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - r); ctx.lineTo(x, y + r);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + r, y); ctx.closePath();
}

function update() {
  if (state !== 1) return;
  if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['a']) pad.x -= pad.spd;
  if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d']) pad.x += pad.spd;
  pad.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - pad.w, pad.x));

  ball.x += ball.dx; ball.y += ball.dy;

  if (ball.x - ball.r < 0) { ball.dx = Math.abs(ball.dx); ball.x = ball.r; }
  if (ball.x + ball.r > W) { ball.dx = -Math.abs(ball.dx); ball.x = W - ball.r; }
  if (ball.y - ball.r < 0) { ball.dy = Math.abs(ball.dy); ball.y = ball.r; }

  if (ball.dy > 0 && ball.y + ball.r >= pad.y && ball.y + ball.r <= pad.y + pad.h + ball.spd && ball.x >= pad.x - ball.r && ball.x <= pad.x + pad.w + ball.r) {
    let hit = (ball.x - (pad.x + pad.w / 2)) / (pad.w / 2);
    ball.dx = hit * ball.spd * 1.2;
    ball.dy = -Math.sqrt(Math.max(0.1, ball.spd * ball.spd - ball.dx * ball.dx));
    ball.y = pad.y - ball.r;
  }

  if (ball.y - ball.r > H) {
    lives--;
    if (lives <= 0) { state = 2; } 
    else { ball.x = pad.x + pad.w / 2; ball.y = pad.y - ball.r; ball.dx = ball.spd * (Math.random() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1); ball.dy = -ball.spd; }
  }

  let alive = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < brick.rows; i++) {
    for (let j = 0; j < brick.cols; j++) {
      let b = bricks[i][j];
      if (!b.alive) continue;
      alive++;
      if (ball.x + ball.r > b.x && ball.x - ball.r < b.x + brick.w && ball.y + ball.r > b.y && ball.y - ball.r < b.y + brick.h) {
        b.alive = 0; alive--; score += 10;
        let ox = Math.min(ball.x + ball.r - b.x, b.x + brick.w - (ball.x - ball.r));
        let oy = Math.min(ball.y + ball.r - b.y, b.y + brick.h - (ball.y - ball.r));
        if (ox < oy) ball.dx *= -1; else ball.dy *= -1;
      }
    }
  }
  if (alive === 0) state = 3;
}

function draw() {
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#282c34'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  if (state === 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#abb2bf'; ctx.font = 'bold 32px sans-serif'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('BREAKOUT', W / 2, H / 2 - 20);
    ctx.font = '16px sans-serif'; ctx.fillText('Click or Space to Start', W / 2, H / 2 + 20);
    return;
  }

  for (let i = 0; i < brick.rows; i++) {
    ctx.fillStyle = colors[i % colors.length];
    for (let j = 0; j < brick.cols; j++) {
      let b = bricks[i][j];
      if (!b.alive) continue;
      rect(b.x, b.y, brick.w, brick.h, 3); ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  ctx.fillStyle = '#abb2bf';
  rect(pad.x, pad.y, pad.w, pad.h, 4); ctx.fill();

  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#e5c07b'; ctx.fill();

  ctx.fillStyle = '#abb2bf'; ctx.font = '16px sans-serif'; ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 12, 30);
  ctx.textAlign = 'right'; ctx.fillText('Lives: ' + lives, W - 12, 30);

  if (state > 1) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.fillStyle = state === 2 ? '#e06c75' : '#98c379';
    ctx.font = 'bold 36px sans-serif'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText(state === 2 ? 'GAME OVER' : 'YOU WIN!', W / 2, H / 2 - 20);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#abb2bf'; ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Click or Space to Restart', W / 2, H / 2 + 20);
  }
}

document.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key] = true; if ((e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter') && state !== 1) init(); });
document.addEventListener('keyup', e => keys[e.key] = false);
c.addEventListener('mousemove', e => { if (state === 1) pad.x = e.clientX - c.getBoundingClientRect().left - pad.w / 2; });
c.addEventListener('touchmove', e => { e.preventDefault(); if (state === 1) pad.x = e.touches[0].clientX - c.getBoundingClientRect().left - pad.w / 2; }, { passive: false });
c.addEventListener('click', () => { if (state !== 1) init(); });

function loop() { update(); draw(); requestAnimationFrame(loop); }
loop();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Pong</title>
<style>
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{width:480px;height:480px;overflow:hidden;background:#0a0a0a}
canvas{display:block;width:480px;height:480px;cursor:none}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" width="960" height="960"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas=document.getElementById('c'),ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
const W=960,H=960,PW=16,PH=120,BR=10,PAD=50;
const WIN=7,SPEED=7,AIM=5.5;

let state='menu',pScore=0,aScore=0,rally=0;
let ball={x:W/2,y:H/2,vx:0,vy:0,speed:SPEED};
let pY=H/2,aY=H/2;
let keys={},pointer=null,shake=0,flash=0;

function resetBall(dir){
  ball.x=W/2;ball.y=H/2;ball.speed=SPEED;rally=0;
  const a=(Math.random()*0.8-0.4);
  ball.vx=dir*Math.cos(a)*ball.speed;
  ball.vy=Math.sin(a)*ball.speed;
}

function startGame(){
  pScore=0;aScore=0;pY=H/2;aY=H/2;
  resetBall(Math.random()<0.5?1:-1);
  state='play';
}

function update(){
  if(state!=='play')return;

  // Player input
  let target=pointer?pointer.y:pY;
  if(keys['ArrowUp']||keys['KeyW'])target=pY-10;
  if(keys['ArrowDown']||keys['KeyS'])target=pY+10;
  pY+=(target-pY)*0.18;
  pY=Math.max(PH/2,Math.min(H-PH/2,pY));

  // AI
  let aiTarget=ball.vx>0?ball.y:H/2;
  let aiDiff=aiTarget-aY;
  let aiMax=AIM*(0.5+Math.min(rally,20)/20);
  aY+=Math.max(-aiMax,Math.min(aiMax,aiDiff));
  aY=Math.max(PH/2,Math.min(H-PH/2,aY));

  // Ball
  ball.x+=ball.vx;ball.y+=ball.vy;

  // Top/bottom walls
  if(ball.y-BR<0){ball.y=BR;ball.vy*=-1}
  if(ball.y+BR>H){ball.y=H-BR;ball.vy*=-1}

  // Player paddle collision (left)
  let pLeft=PAD+PW;
  if(ball.vx<0&&ball.x-BR<=pLeft&&ball.x+BR>=PAD){
    if(ball.y>=pY-PH/2-BR&&ball.y<=pY+PH/2+BR){
      ball.x=pLeft+BR;
      let hit=(ball.y-pY)/(PH/2);
      let angle=hit*Math.PI/3.5;
      ball.speed=Math.min(ball.speed+0.15,14);
      ball.vx=Math.cos(angle)*ball.speed;
      ball.vy=Math.sin(angle)*ball.speed;
      rally++;shake=4;
    }
  }

  // AI paddle collision (right)
  let aRight=W-PAD-PW;
  if(ball.vx>0&&ball.x+BR>=aRight&&ball.x-BR<=W-PAD){
    if(ball.y>=aY-PH/2-BR&&ball.y<=aY+PH/2+BR){
      ball.x=aRight-BR;
      let hit=(ball.y-aY)/(PH/2);
      let angle=Math.PI-hit*Math.PI/3.5;
      ball.speed=Math.min(ball.speed+0.15,14);
      ball.vx=Math.cos(angle)*ball.speed;
      ball.vy=Math.sin(angle)*ball.speed;
      rally++;shake=4;
    }
  }

  // Scoring
  if(ball.x<-BR*2){aScore++;flash=8;checkEnd()}
  if(ball.x>W+BR*2){pScore++;flash=8;checkEnd()}
}

function checkEnd(){
  if(pScore>=WIN||aScore>=WIN){state='over'}
  else{resetBall(ball.x<W/2?-1:1)}
}

function draw(){
  ctx.save();
  if(shake>0){ctx.translate(Math.random()*shake-shake/2,Math.random()*shake-shake/2);shake*=0.7;if(shake<0.3)shake=0}

  // Background
  ctx.fillStyle='#0a0a0a';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);

  // Center line
  ctx.setLineDash([16,16]);ctx.strokeStyle='#1a1a1a';ctx.lineWidth=3;
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(W/2,0);ctx.lineTo(W/2,H);ctx.stroke();
  ctx.setLineDash([]);

  // Center circle
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(W/2,H/2,60,0,Math.PI*2);
  ctx.strokeStyle='#1a1a1a';ctx.lineWidth=3;ctx.stroke();

  // Flash on score
  if(flash>0){ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(255,255,255,${flash*0.015})`;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);flash--}

  // Scores
  ctx.fillStyle='#1a1a1a';ctx.font='bold 200px sans-serif';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';
  ctx.fillText(pScore,W/2-160,H/2);
  ctx.fillText(aScore,W/2+160,H/2);

  // Paddles
  ctx.shadowColor='#fff';ctx.shadowBlur=20;
  ctx.fillStyle='#e0e0e0';
  drawRoundRect(PAD,pY-PH/2,PW,PH,6);
  drawRoundRect(W-PAD-PW,aY-PH/2,PW,PH,6);
  ctx.shadowBlur=0;

  // Ball
  ctx.shadowColor='#fff';ctx.shadowBlur=25;
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff';
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(ball.x,ball.y,BR,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
  ctx.shadowBlur=0;

  // Rally indicator
  if(state==='play'&&rally>3){
    ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(255,255,255,${Math.min(rally*0.03,0.3)})`;
    ctx.font='bold 28px sans-serif';ctx.textAlign='center';
    ctx.fillText(rally+' hit rally',W/2,40);
  }

  // Overlays
  if(state==='menu'){
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(10,10,10,0.85)';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    ctx.fillStyle='#e0e0e0';ctx.font='bold 90px sans-serif';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';
    ctx.fillText('PONG',W/2,H/2-80);
    ctx.fillStyle='#666';ctx.font='24px sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('First to '+WIN+' wins',W/2,H/2);
    ctx.fillStyle='#888';ctx.font='22px sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Click or press Space to start',W/2,H/2+60);
    ctx.fillText('↑↓ / W S / Mouse to move',W/2,H/2+100);
  }

  if(state==='over'){
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(10,10,10,0.85)';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    ctx.fillStyle=pScore>=WIN?'#e0e0e0':'#e0e0e0';
    ctx.font='bold 70px sans-serif';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';
    ctx.fillText(pScore>=WIN?'You Win':'You Lose',W/2,H/2-60);
    ctx.fillStyle='#888';ctx.font='36px sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText(pScore+' – '+aScore,W/2,H/2+10);
    ctx.fillStyle='#666';ctx.font='22px sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Click or press Space to restart',W/2,H/2+70);
  }

  ctx.restore();
}

function drawRoundRect(x,y,w,h,r){
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x+r,y);ctx.lineTo(x+w-r,y);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+r);
  ctx.lineTo(x+w,y+h-r);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x+w,y+h,x+w-r,y+h);
  ctx.lineTo(x+r,y+h);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x,y+h,x,y+h-r);
  ctx.lineTo(x,y+r);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x,y,x+r,y);
  ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();
}

function loop(){update();draw();requestAnimationFrame(loop)}

document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
  keys[e.code]=true;
  if(e.code==='Space'){e.preventDefault();if(state!=='play')startGame()}
});
document.addEventListener('keyup',e=>{keys[e.code]=false});

canvas.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{
  const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  pointer={y:(e.clientY-r.top)/r.height*H};
});
canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{
  e.preventDefault();
  const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  pointer={y:(e.clientY-r.top)/r.height*H};
  if(state!=='play')startGame();
});
canvas.addEventListener('pointerleave',()=>{pointer=null});

loop();
</script>
</body>
</html>

pongEntries.html:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Pong</title>
<style>
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
body{background:#08080c;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;min-height:100vh;font-family:system-ui,sans-serif}
#c{display:block;border-radius:4px;cursor:none}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" width="480" height="480"></canvas>
<script>
const C=document.getElementById('c'),X=C.getContext('2d'),W=480,H=480;
const G=10,PW=80,PH=8,BR=6,BS=5,PS=3;
let player={x:W/2-PW/2,y:H-G-PH-4,w:PW,h:PH,v:0},
    opp={x:W/2-PW/2,y:G+4,w:PW,h:PH},
    ball={x:W/2,y:H/2,vx:BS*(Math.random()>.5?1:-1),vy:BS*(Math.random()>.5?1:-1),r:BR},
    ps=0,os=0,started=0,particles=[];

function reset(){
  ball.x=W/2;ball.y=H/2;
  ball.vx=BS*(Math.random()>.5?1:-1);
  ball.vy=BS*(Math.random()>.5?1:-1);
}
function spawnParticles(x,y,c){
  for(let i=0;i<8;i++){
    const a=Math.random()*Math.PI*2;
    particles.push({x,y,vx:Math.cos(a)*(2+Math.random()*3),vy:Math.sin(a)*(2+Math.random()*3),life:1,c});
  }
}
function update(){
  if(!started)return;
  player.x+=player.v;
  player.x=Math.max(0,Math.min(W-player.w,player.x));
  opp.x+=(ball.x-opp.x-opp.w/2)*0.04;
  opp.x=Math.max(0,Math.min(W-opp.w,opp.x));
  ball.x+=ball.vx;ball.y+=ball.vy;
  if(ball.x<=ball.r||ball.x>=W-ball.r){ball.vx*=-1;ball.x=Math.max(ball.r,Math.min(W-ball.r,ball.x))}
  if(ball.y-ball.r<=G+opp.h+4){
    if(ball.x>=opp.x&&ball.x<=opp.x+opp.w){
      ball.vy=BS;ball.vx+=(ball.x-opp.x-opp.w/2)*0.15;
      spawnParticles(ball.x,G+opp.h+4,'#4af');
    }
  }
  if(ball.y+ball.r>=H-G-player.h-4){
    if(ball.x>=player.x&&ball.x<=player.x+player.w){
      ball.vy=-BS;ball.vx+=(ball.x-player.x-player.w/2)*0.15;
      spawnParticles(ball.x,H-G-player.h-4,'#f84');
    }
  }
  const sp=Math.sqrt(ball.vx**2+ball.vy**2);
  if(sp>BS*1.5){const f=BS*1.5/sp;ball.vx*=f;ball.vy*=f}
  if(ball.y<-ball.r){os++;reset()}
  if(ball.y>H+ball.r){ps++;reset()}
  particles=particles.filter(p=>{p.x+=p.vx;p.y+=p.vy;p.life-=0.03;return p.life>0});
}
function draw(){
  X.fillStyle='#0c0c14';X.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  X.strokeStyle='#1a1a2a';X.setLineDash([8,8]);X.lineWidth=2;
  X.beginPath();X.moveTo(0,H/2);X.lineTo(W,H/2);X.stroke();X.setLineDash([]);
  X.fillStyle='#2a2a3a';X.fillRect(player.x,H-G-player.h,player.w,player.h);
  X.fillRect(opp.x,G,opp.w,opp.h);
  X.shadowColor='#fff';X.shadowBlur=started?12:0;
  X.fillStyle='#fff';X.beginPath();X.arc(ball.x,ball.y,ball.r,0,Math.PI*2);X.fill();
  X.shadowBlur=0;
  particles.forEach(p=>{X.globalAlpha=p.life;X.fillStyle=p.c;X.fillRect(p.x-2,p.y-2,4,4)});
  X.globalAlpha=1;
  X.fillStyle='#444';X.font='bold 36px system-ui';X.textAlign='center';
  X.fillText(os,W/2,H/2-50);X.fillText(ps,W/2,H/2+70);
  if(!started){
    X.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.7)';X.font='16px system-ui';
    X.fillText('Click or press Space to start',W/2,H/2+4);
  }
}
function loop(){update();draw();requestAnimationFrame(loop)}
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
  if(e.key=='ArrowLeft')player.v=-PS;
  if(e.key=='ArrowRight')player.v=PS;
  if(e.key==' '&&!started){started=1;reset()}
});
document.addEventListener('keyup',e=>{
  if(e.key=='ArrowLeft'&&player.v<0||e.key=='ArrowRight'&&player.v>0)player.v=0;
});
C.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{
  const r=C.getBoundingClientRect();
  player.x=e.clientX-r.left-player.w/2;
});
C.addEventListener('click',()=>{if(!started){started=1;reset()}});
loop();
</script>
</body>
</html>
